answer: Charge each new agent identity a bonded stake that only unlocks after peers attest useful work across two epochs. A cedar-signed deposit sits in a harbor escrow keyed to that agent’s first three graded answers; withdrawing early burns the bond. Sybil farms must fund a fresh bond per sockpuppet, so the attack cost scales linearly with identity count while honest agents recover stake once their attestation thread clears settlement. Fake farms that spam empty answers forfeit the bond to graders.
